avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP2B6 induction reduces bupropion levels; increased risk of treatment failure and seizures
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort; allow 2-week washout before or after bupropion initiation

avoid_supplements.name: MAO Inhibitors (including supplements containing phenylethylamine)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Risk of hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome, and increased seizure risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid all MAO inhibitors; maintain 14-day separation between discontinuation and bupropion initiation

avoid_supplements.name: Stimulant supplements (e.g., excessive caffeine, ephedrine, yohimbine)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive stimulant effects increase risk of hypertension, tachycardia, anxiety, and seizures
avoid_supplements.action: Limit caffeine intake to <200mg daily; avoid ephedrine and yohimbine-containing products

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild anticoagulant properties; theoretical additive seizure risk at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for unusual bleeding; use standard doses only

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate stimulant effects and increase seizure threshold
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; monitor for increased agitation or tremor

avoid_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented products)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Bupropion has weak MAOI activity; excessive tyramine may precipitate hypertensive crisis
avoid_foods.action: Counsel on moderation of high-tyramine foods; avoid excessive quantities of aged cheeses, cured meats, soy sauce, and fermented products

caution_foods.name: High-caffeine foods and beverages (coffee, energy drinks, chocolate)
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive stimulant effects may increase anxiety, insomnia, tremor, and lower seizure threshold
caution_foods.action: Limit caffeine to <200mg daily; monitor tolerance

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: CNS depression may be altered; alcohol lowers seizure threshold
caution_foods.action: Minimize alcohol consumption; counsel on seizure risk and CNS effects

monitoring_notes: Monitor for seizures (risk 0.4%), hypertension, and stimulant-related adverse effects (insomnia, agitation, tremor). Assess CYP2D6 status if co-prescribing drugs requiring CYP2D6 metabolism, as bupropion is a strong CYP2D6 inhibitor.
